text:
anya: Quick sync  locking the opt-in + safety lightswitch plan for payments.route.v2. Customer-driven launch; we need per-tenant optins, short ops watches, and clear auto-fallback rules.
kevin: LGTM. Suggest micro-canary then regional warmup. Keep default = shadow.
anya: Proposed phases: darklaunch 24h (internal traffic only), micro-canary us-west-2 0.5% for 30m, regional warmup us-west-2 + us-east-1 5% for 4h, staged ramp to 20% over 24h, then conditional ramp to 100% over 48h.
marcus: Kill-switch rules: auto-fallback if error_rate >= 2x baseline for 3m OR p95 latency delta > 150ms for 5m. Immediate fallback if any tenant has >1% absolute drop in success_rate.
jordan: Metric gating: require payment_success non-inferior within 0.2% and downstream conversion CI stable before >20%. Will add a CI gate to CD pipeline.
linda: Sales note: platinum customers want early opt-in. We'll support per-tenant 100% override + a 24h removal/grace window. Need admin UI toggle and audit log.
kevin: Flag model (example payload in comments): {flag: payments.v2_enabled, strategies: [{scope:tenant, id:T-PLAT-900, pct:100},{scope:region, id:us-west-2, pct:0.5}], kill_conditions: {err_mult:2.0, p95_ms:150}}
marcus: Ops watch windows: two 90m windows on launch day (09:00-10:30 PT, 14:00-15:30 PT). Pager path: oncall -> infra lead -> eng-sre. Add runbook link.
anya: I'll author RB-2026-371 runbook and list approvers for each window. Auto-postmortem trigger if fallback occurs.
kevin: Fallback behavior: route traffic to payments.route.v1, set flag state to "lightswitch-failed" and prevent auto-reenable for 24h.
jordan: Also run a two-week 15% A/B test on non-critical flows (search, recs) to surface latent regressions. Tag telemetry with experiment_id and cohort.
linda: Add a manual "pause" button in admin console so customers can opt-out immediately; product+security signoff required. Add email notification to tenant ops when toggled.
marcus: Preflight checklist: shadow smoke tests pass; dashboards (error_rate, p50/p95/p99, success_rate, per-tenant failures); alerts wired to runbook; rollout inhibit if infra CPU >75% or error budget low.
anya: Gate before regional warmup: no hard-latch triggers, p95 within 1.2x baseline, no customer escalations, CI gate passes.
kevin: Timeline recap: Day0 darklaunch, Day1 micro-canary, Day1 warmup, Day2-3 staged ramp to 20%, Day3-5 full ramp if stable.
anya: Owners: ops owns micro-canary go/no-go, product+eng approve warmup and staged ramps. Approvers listed in RB-2026-371.
marcus: I'll wire automation to flip the flag to fallback on kill conditions and post to #incidents via ops-bot.
ops-bot: Automation note: fallback hooks configured. Will post state changes and tag oncall. :gear: 
linda: I'll share the platinum opt-in CSV by EOD and confirm UI timeline.
jordan: I'll publish the experiment dashboard and add the CI check to block >20% if samples insufficient.
kevin: I'll open the flag PR and admin UI stub; requesting security review.
anya: Thanks all  posting this as canonical plan. Target micro-canary Fri 09:00 PT. Ping me in-thread for updates. :white_check_mark:
